title: Dynamic networks of PTSD symptoms during conflict
network_types: temporal network, contemporaneous network, between-person network
limitations: - No adequate fit statistics for model assessment; - Only models linear processes, ignores non-linear trends; - Assumes stationarity, which may not hold for PTSD; - Limited sample size prevented inclusion of covariates like gender, trauma history, exposure severity
